'''Cissy''' (Japanese: '''アツミ''' ''Atsumi'') is the [[Gym Leader]] of the [[Mikan Island]]'s [[Gym]], known officially as the [[Mikan Gym]]. She hands out the {{Badge|Coral-Eye}} to {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who defeat her.

==History==
Cissy debuted when {{Ash}} challenged her for the Coral-Eye Badge in ''[[EP085|Fit To Be Tide]]''.

Ash discovered that Cissy, like the rest of the Orange Crew, conducts a different kind of Gym {{pkmn|battle}} than what he was used to in the [[Indigo League]]. The first part of the match is an accuracy test where both {{pkmn|Trainer}}s have their Pokémon use {{m|Water Gun}} to accurately hit targets. The second test is a {{m|surf}}ing race around some buoys near the coast. While Ash and Cissy had a draw in the first challenge, Ash prevailed in the second challenge after having {{AP|Lapras}} use its {{m|Ice Beam}}, thus winning the Badge.

She reappeared in flashbacks in ''[[EP098|A Way Off Day Off]]'', ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]'', and ''[[EP113|Viva Las Lapras]]''.

==Character==
According to {{Tracey}}, Cissy is known as one of the toughest Trainers in the [[Orange League|Orange Crew]]. She specializes in {{type|Water}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, and one of the rules of her [[Gym]] is that her opponents are required to use Water-type Pokémon as well.

She lives with her little brother, {{OBP|Senta|EP085}}, who is also a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and serves as a {{cat|Gym assistants|Gym assistant}}. The pair have a good relationship, though she is prepared to pull Senta into line if he is misbehaving.

Cissy is confident in her abilities and certain of her Pokémon's power. She proudly showed off her {{p|Seadra}}'s {{m|Water Gun}} control during the first challenge. While she has a strong competitive spirit, Cissy will also commend a challenger's abilities and clever tactics.
